title: Bun API key store
context: Issues and checks API keys on bun:sqlite. Only a SHA-256 hash of each key is stored and the full key is shown to the user once and never logged. Revoked keys must be rejected. Users may only revoke their own keys.
code: db.run("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS api_keys (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, owner TEXT NOT NULL, prefix TEXT NOT NULL, hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, revoked_at INTEGER, last_used_at INTEGER, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)");
db.query("INSERT INTO api_keys (owner, prefix, hash, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)").run(owner, key.slice(0, 10), sha256(key), Date.now());
const row = db.query("SELECT id, owner FROM api_keys WHERE hash = ?").get(sha256(key)) as { id: number; owner: string } | null;
db.query("UPDATE api_keys SET last_used_at = ? WHERE id = ?").run(Date.now(), row.id);

const res = db.query("UPDATE api_keys SET revoked_at = ? WHERE prefix = ? AND revoked_at IS NULL").run(Date.now(), prefix);

expected.why: the full secret key is written to the logs
revoked keys are still accepted; the query must also require revoked_at IS NULL
no owner filter, so any user can revoke another user's key by its prefix
